scientific_integrity: All steps are supplied as an elementary integer proof and a self-contained finite checker; no claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The result determines existence of zero Walsh multipliers, not their multiplicities or sharp spectral norms; the domain is maximal independent sets of simple cycles with binary Walsh characters. Earlier equivalent signed specializations may have escaped the bounded literature comparison.
title: A modulo-fourteen Walsh invertibility law for cyclic maximal independent sets
